study_identification_part.si_4_title: Characterizing the distinct imaging phenotypes, clinical behavior, and genetic vulnerability of brain maturational subtypes in mood disorders

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: All participants (404 HC, 174 drug-naïve/drug-free patients in discovery cohort, and 268 medicated patients in replication cohort) were recruited and scanned at the First Affiliated Hospital of China Medical University, Shenyang, China, using a single Signa HDx 3.0T MRI system (GE Healthcare).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "All the patients were recruited from the inpatient department of the Shenyang Mental Health Center and the outpatient clinic of the Department of Psychiatry of the First Affiliated Hospital of China Medical University, Shenyang, China." "Structural MRI scanning was conducted on a Signa HDx 3.0 T superconductive MRI system (GE Healthcare, Little Chalfont, UK) at the First Affiliated Hospital, China Medical University."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Zheng2024.pdf.md: Methods and materials / Participants, L69; Image acquisition and MRI processing, L73

answer.SINGLE-SITE: normative model training (404 HC); clinical application / subtyping (174 drug-naïve/drug-free patients as discovery dataset 1; 268 medicated patients as replication dataset 2)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The 404 healthy controls were used to build normative GMV curves via quantile regression. The 174 drug-naïve/drug-free patients (114 MDD + 60 BD) constituted the discovery dataset (dataset 1) for subtyping analysis. The 268 medicated patients (142 MDD + 126 BD) comprised the replication/validation dataset (dataset 2).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "We recruited 114 MDD patients, 60 BD patients and 404 healthy controls (HC)." "In this study, the 174 drugfree patients constitute the discovery dataset (dataset 1), while the 268 medicated patients comprise the validated dataset (dataset 2)." "To validate the imaging phenotypes, we involved 268 patients who received medication treatment as the replication cohort."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Zheng2024.pdf.md: Methods and materials / Participants, L69; GMV normative deviation calculation and subtypes clustering, L83

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: A single normative model was constructed using quantile regression on regional GMV as a function of age and sex, based on all 404 healthy controls. The paper does not describe a separate train/test split of the HC for the normative model itself.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "We recruited 114 MDD patients, 60 BD patients and 404 healthy controls (HC)." "Quantile regression was used to obtain a normative range of regional GMV variation as a function of age and sex descripted in a previous study (Lv et al., 2021)." "individual deviation z-scores for each brain region, representing the difference from normative GMV calculated across all HC individuals."
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Zheng2024.pdf.md: Methods and materials / Participants, L69; GMV normative deviation calculation and subtypes clustering, L82-L83; S0033291724000886sup001.docx.md: Table S1, L56-L58

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age information for the 404 HC is reported as mean ± sd in Supplementary Table S1. No separate train/test split of HC is described, so overall-phase reflects the full HC sample. Min/max age is not explicitly reported; however, the paper mentions some participants were under 18 years (K-SADS-PL was used for those under 18), suggesting the range spans adolescence to adulthood, but exact values are not provided.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "Age 29.0±9.3" (HC column in Table S1). "the Structured Clinical Interview for the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, 4th Edition, Text Revision (DSM-IV-TR) in patients aged 18 years and older and the Schedule for Affective Disorders and Schizophrenia for School-Age Children-present and Lifetime Version (K-SADS-PL) in those patients under the age of 18 years."

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Sex information for the 404 HC is reported as male/female = 160/244 in Supplementary Table S1. Percentages calculated: male 160/404 = 39.6%, female 244/404 = 60.4%. No separate train/test split of HC is described.
